2.3.32 Report.PageWidth
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Report.PageWidth element specifies the default width for rendering each Page of a Report in a
physical-page oriented renderer. The Report.PageWidth element is optional. If this element is
present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as
"8.5in".
Following is the parent element of the Report.PageWidth element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.PageWidth element.
 <xsd:element name="PageWidth" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
